newsitem.title: GERMANY: Pro Sieben says June market share rises.
newsitem.headline: Pro Sieben says June market share rises.

text.p: German television group Pro Sieben AG, in the middle of an initial public offering, said on Tuesday that its market share of all German viewers for its two domestic networks had risen slightly in June.
Its Pro Sieben network's market share in June compared with May had risen half a point to 9.6 percent, while the Kabel 1 network's share remained at four percent.

Pro Sieben, citing data from the GfK television research group, said the network's top competitors lost market share during the month as RTL fell 1.1 percentage points to 15.9 percent and Sat. 1 fell 1.4 percentage points to 13 percent.
German public network ARD rose to 14.9 percent in June from 13.7 percent, while the second public network ZDF rose to 12.9 percent from 12.8 percent, Pro Sieben said in a statement.

Pro Sieben is scheduled later this week to release the issue price for its initial public offering. The bookbuilding range has been set at 66 to 72 marks but the share has been trading at about 110 marks in grey market dealings.
